registered.position: long when green, flat when red; signal at the close of day t sets the position on day t+1

fills.fantasy: Heikin-Ashi close-to-close return (the tag); untradeable, included only to size the gap

registered.portfolio: equal weight across names signalled long; cash when none

random_traders.method: per-name long/flat states shuffled, preserving each name exposure fraction

registered.universe: union of the top-800 liquid US common stocks on the first trading day of each year 2004-2026, delisted names on their live dates

predictions.P1: P1 — Rendering adds ~nothing. At 0 bps, HA-trend and raw-candle-trend have materially indistinguishable Sharpe (|ΔSharpe| < 0.15). If HA-trend's Sharpe exceeds raw-trend's by ≥0.15 net, the rendering claim survives this cut.
predictions.P2: P2 — The apparent edge is the fantasy fill. HA-FANTASY Sharpe/CAGR ≫ HONEST (a large, obviously-inflated gap), demonstrating that the [a misquote of the video, replaced here by its own words: “it almost feels like cheating”] smoothness is a fill you cannot get.
predictions.P3: P3 — Doesn't beat holding. Net of 10 bps, HONEST HA-trend underperforms the B&H composite on CAGR (the smoothing lags reversals; active turnover pays friction for no edge).
predictions.P4: P4 — Not a monkey-beat. HONEST HA-trend Sharpe sits inside the random-timing null distribution (does not exceed its 95th percentile).

lines.kill: KILL (thesis confirmed): P1 (Sharpe parity at 0 bps) and P3 (loses to B&H net) both hold → rendering is not its own edge; verdict = KILL, with P2 as the "where the illusion comes from" number-pair.
lines.rescue: SURVIVE (thesis wounded): P1 fails (HA-trend beats raw-trend by ≥0.15 Sharpe net) and P4 fails (beats the null's 95th pct) → HA rendering carries a real, tradeable edge → escalate to intraday reproduction before any KILL is narrated.
lines.mixed: Mixed → report honestly as inconclusive; do not narrate a verdict.
